draft: We operate in the engineering sector, where our Company engages in the manufacture of precision machined components and sub-assemblies for commercial vehicle and off-highway powertrain applications, supplied directly to original equipment manufacturers. Our product lines comprise precision machined transmission components, axle and differential sub-assemblies, and hydraulic valve bodies for off-highway equipment. Our primary market is focused within the State of Maharashtra, where we serve our targeted original equipment manufacturer clients.
